newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Dec gas rallies near contract high on ACCESS.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Dec gas rallies near contract high on ACCESS.

text.p: NYMEX natural gas futures extended a day-session rally in after-hours ACCESS trade, with spot-December driven near its contract high by reports of further gains in the cash, industry sources said.

Front-month December rallied 6.5 cents on ACCESS to $2.86 per million British thermal units before retreating to $2.85 at 1845 EST. The move was just a half cent shy of the $2.865 contract high set on June 28. Other months were up by about one to four cents.
During the day session, December gained 6.4 cents to close at $2.795, while deferreds finished one to 6.9 cents higher.

"Cash won't quit. We heard some Midcon (Midcontinent) pipes were up near $2.80 this afternoon," said one East Coast trader, adding cool Midwest weather and forecasts for more of the same into early November helped trigger the buying spree this week.

November Midcontinent cash prices have gained more than 30 cents, or about 15 percent, since Friday, but some traders said extended (11-15 day) forecasts show a return to more seasonal temperatures in the region and could limit further gains.
